meta.name: render-offer-ad
meta.description: Render a punchy ~12s vertical (9:16) music-only direct-response OFFER ad as a 4-beat kinetic-typography film — HEADLINE slam → real PRODUCT drop → CLAIM/proof → CTA pill — from one config of copy slots, a real product photo, a brand palette, fonts, bpm, and beat split. DETERMINISTIC + FREE (a bundled Remotion project; springs + interpolate, no AI-gen for visuals). Backgrounds are engine gradient divs off the palette, props are inline SVG, the ONLY composited bitmap is the REAL product photo (objectFit:contain, never stretched), and ALL headline/claim/CTA/URL/wordmark text is typeset in the engine — never AI-rendered (the format's credibility guard). A driver binds the config to Remotion input props, renders the 9:16 master, and derives a 1:1 center-crop with ffmpeg. Two gating checks run before render (claim verbs must match the product's physical format; the claim beat needs an edge-entry mechanism prop). Use for the motion-graphics-offer-ad format.

copy.tagline: 把文案和产品图自动生成竖版音乐广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成品牌竖版音乐广告视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn copy and product photo into a vertical music ad video automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate branded vertical music ad videos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的文案、产品图、品牌色等配置，自动生成一段约12秒的竖屏音乐广告视频。视频包含四个节奏段落：标题逐字弹出、产品展示、卖点证明、行动号召按钮。所有文字都是引擎渲染，不使用AI生成图像。
howto.when: 当你需要制作一个简洁有力的产品促销广告视频，并且已经准备好产品图片、文案和品牌配色时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个饮料产品的广告视频，产品图是这张，文案是“清爽一夏”。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供完整的配置信息，然后生成视频。

say.text: 用这个品牌色和字体，为我的胶囊保健品做一个12秒广告。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate a ~12-second vertical music ad video from your copy, product photo, brand palette, etc. The video has 4 beats: headline slams in word-by-word, product drop, claim/proof, and CTA pill. All text is engine-rendered, no AI-generated visuals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a concise product offer ad video and have prepared product image, copy, and brand colors.

say_en.text: Generate an ad video for a beverage product, product photo is this, copy is 'Refreshing Summer'.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for full config and then generate the video.

say_en.text: Use this brand palette and fonts to make a 12s ad for my capsule supplement.
Turn this copy into an ad video: headline 'New Arrival', claim 'Natural Ingredients', CTA 'Buy Now'.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product photo, brand colors, etc.
